body:
maria: Quickstart (docker starter) fails on first generation after signup. curl -> 402 but message says "trial credits exhausted". anyone seen a UX like this? :thinking:

kevin: which org/workspace and which endpoint (staging vs prod)?

maria: org: org-nova. using prod endpoint in README. repro curl below:

maria: ```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hello"}]}'
# => HTTP/1.1 402 Payment Required
# {"error":"workspace_payment_required","message":"Trial credits exhausted: 0 tokens remaining"}
```

ash: 402 with explicit "credits exhausted" is different from "attach payment method". Did this org already use trial on another workspace or sandbox?

maria: this is a fresh signup. we used the same org name earlier in a hackday sandbox, could that have consumed the org-level trial?

jules-billing: checking org state: org-nova shows trial_flag=true but remaining_trial_tokens=0 because a previous sandbox workspace consumed the allocation. the backend treats zero-credits as workspace_payment_required (402).

kevin: ah that explains it. marketing docs imply new invite gets fresh trial, but allocation is org-scoped. that's confusing for new users following the quickstart.

maria: can billing temporarily top up or enable a one-off dev allocation so my CI smoke tests can pass?

jules-billing: I can add a temporary 5M token dev grant to org-nova for 24h. applying now.

maria: re-run in ~20s  success! :tada: completions 200 and tokens consumed. CI smoke green.

maria: follow-up requests: 1) docs: clarify trial is org-scoped and show command to check remaining trial tokens 2) API/SDK: 402 body should include a console link and a short hint (e.g., "View billing and remaining trial tokens: /console/orgs/org-nova/billing") 3) SDK: map 402->BillingRequiredError and surface remaining tokens in the exception 4) quickstart README: add `redwood billing status` example and a short note about org-scoped trials

kevin: filing a devex ticket to update quickstart README + CLI helper `redwood billing status --org org-nova`. also adding an SDK issue to include remaining_trial_tokens on error objects.

jules-billing: created case #7894: "Org-scoped trial confusion: zero remaining tokens -> 402" assigned: jules-billing, console-team. priority: P3.

onboard-bot: case #7894 opened. "Org-scoped trial confusion"
